description: 강원도_강릉소방차진입불가도로 [roads, bridges and tunnels and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 강원특별자치도. 강원특별자치도 내 소방차 진입 불가 지역을 파악하기 위해 도로명주소 기반의 도로를 도출하고, 각 도로에 대한 실폭(도로 폭) 정보를 추가하여 구축한 데이터입니다. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
